property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true (completes and returns true); the mutant returns false despite completing, violating this return-value property for some inputs.

For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always attempts the external calls and thus will revert if the callee reverts for any element; the mutant that returns early breaks this by never performing external calls, so it will never revert even when the callee would revert.
